name: app_workflow_v1
description: Real-world multi-step app workflows — covers messaging, content creation, information retrieval, and utility tasks on a real phone device.
prompt_prefix: 你正在操作一台通过 HDMI 采集画面的手机。请使用截图、touch_gesture、keyboard_text、keyboard_tap 等工具完成任务。每步操作后截图确认状态再继续。如果某个操作没有生效，不要重复点击同一位置，尝试其他方式。

global_reset.prompt: 请返回主屏幕，确保当前停留在桌面。

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must open WeChat, find a specific contact (文件传输助手), type a message and send it successfully.
tasks.prompt: 请打开微信，找到「文件传输助手」，发送一条消息：「Benchmark测试消息」，发送后截图确认消息已发出。

rubric.check: Trace shows agent opened WeChat app.
Trace shows agent navigated to 文件传输助手 chat.
Trace shows agent typed Benchmark测试消息.
Post-screenshot shows Benchmark测试消息 as a sent message in the chat.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must open WeChat, navigate to Moments, create a text-only post with specified content, and publish it.

setup.prompt: 请打开微信，停留在微信主界面。

tasks.prompt: 请进入朋友圈，发布一条纯文字动态，内容为：「Aiden Benchmark 测试动态」。发布后截图确认动态已出现在朋友圈列表中。

rubric.check: Trace shows agent navigated to WeChat Moments page.
Trace shows agent opened the compose/publish UI for Moments.
Trace shows agent typed Aiden Benchmark 测试动态.
Post-screenshot shows Aiden Benchmark 测试动态 visible in the Moments feed.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must open Xiaohongshu, create a new image+text note: select a photo, write title and body, then publish.

setup.prompt: 请确保相册中至少有一张图片可供选择，然后回到桌面。

tasks.prompt: 请打开小红书，发布一篇图文笔记：从相册选择第一张图片，标题写「Benchmark测试笔记」，正文写「这是一篇自动化测试发布的笔记」，然后点击发布。发布后截图确认。

rubric.check: Trace shows agent opened 小红书 app.
Trace shows agent entered the note creation/publish flow.
Trace shows agent selected an image from the gallery.
Trace shows agent typed Benchmark测试笔记 as title.
Trace shows agent typed 这是一篇自动化测试发布的笔记 as body.
Post-screenshot shows the note was published successfully (publish confirmation or note visible in profile).

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must open a notes/memo app, create a new note with specific content, save it, exit, then reopen and verify the content persists.
tasks.prompt: 请打开备忘录（或任何可编辑文本的应用），新建一篇笔记，输入标题「测试备忘」，内容「Aiden 自动化验证内容，时间戳 2026」。保存后退出备忘录，再重新打开备忘录找到这篇笔记，截图确认内容完整。

rubric.check: Trace shows agent opened a notes/memo app.
Trace shows agent created a new note and typed the specified title and content.
Trace shows agent left the notes app (returned to home or switched away).
Trace shows agent reopened the notes app and navigated to the saved note.
Post-screenshot shows the note with 测试备忘 and Aiden 自动化验证内容，时间戳 2026 visible.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must open the browser, search for a keyword, and open the first result page.
tasks.prompt: 请打开浏览器，在搜索引擎中搜索「Aiden AI assistant」，点击第一个搜索结果进入页面，截图确认页面已加载。

rubric.check: Trace shows agent opened a browser app.
Trace shows agent typed Aiden AI assistant and submitted a search.
Trace shows agent tapped on the first search result link.
Post-screenshot shows a loaded webpage (not the search results page).

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must open a maps app, search for a destination, and view the navigation route.
tasks.prompt: 请打开地图应用，搜索「上海东方明珠」，查看从当前位置到该地点的导航路线，截图确认路线已显示。

rubric.check: Trace shows agent opened a maps app.
Trace shows agent searched for 上海东方明珠.
Post-screenshot shows a navigation route or directions to 东方明珠 (route line, time estimate, or step list visible).

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must open the camera app, take a photo, and confirm it was saved to the gallery.
tasks.prompt: 请打开相机，拍一张照片，然后进入相册确认刚才拍的照片已保存。截图确认相册中有最新照片。

rubric.check: Trace shows agent opened the camera app.
Trace shows agent tapped the shutter button to take a photo.
Trace shows agent navigated to the photo gallery/album.
Post-screenshot shows the gallery with a recent photo visible (timestamp or thumbnail confirms recency).

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must open the calendar app and create a complete event with title, time, and location.
tasks.prompt: 请打开日历应用，创建一个新日程：标题「项目评审会议」，时间明天下午 2:00 到 3:00，地点「3号会议室」。保存后截图确认日程已创建。

rubric.check: Trace shows agent opened a calendar app.
Trace shows agent opened the new event creation UI.
Trace shows agent typed 项目评审会议 as the event title.
Trace shows agent set the event time to tomorrow 14:00-15:00 (or 2:00 PM - 3:00 PM).
Trace shows agent typed 3号会议室 as the location.
Post-screenshot shows the calendar with 项目评审会议 event visible.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must open WeChat, find a received message in one chat, long-press to forward it to another contact.

setup.prompt: 请打开微信，进入「文件传输助手」对话，发送一条消息「待转发内容」，然后回到微信主界面。

tasks.prompt: 请进入「文件传输助手」对话，找到最近一条消息，长按转发给任意一个其他联系人或群聊。转发后截图确认消息已发送到目标对话。

rubric.check: Trace shows agent entered 文件传输助手 chat.
Trace shows agent long-pressed on a message to trigger context menu.
Trace shows agent selected the forward option from the context menu.
Trace shows agent selected a target contact or group for forwarding.
Post-screenshot shows the forwarded message in the target chat or a send-success confirmation.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must open Xiaohongshu, search for a topic, open the first post, like it, save/collect it, then return to the feed.
tasks.prompt: 请打开小红书，搜索「旅行攻略」，打开第一篇笔记，点赞并收藏该笔记，然后返回搜索结果页，截图确认点赞和收藏状态。

rubric.check: Trace shows agent opened 小红书 app.
Trace shows agent searched for 旅行攻略.
Trace shows agent tapped and opened the first post from search results.
Trace shows agent tapped the like button on the post.
Trace shows agent tapped the collect/save button on the post.
Post-screenshot shows the search results or feed page (agent navigated back from the post).

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must open Taobao, search for a product, select one, and proceed through the purchase flow until reaching the payment page. Agent must NOT complete payment.
tasks.prompt: 请打开淘宝，搜索「充电宝」，选择第一个商品，点击购买，进入下单流程，走到支付页面后停止（不要实际支付）。截图确认已到达支付页面。

rubric.check: Trace shows agent opened 淘宝 app.
Trace shows agent searched for 充电宝.
Trace shows agent tapped on a product from the search results to view details.
Trace shows agent tapped a buy/purchase button (立即购买 or 加入购物车+结算).
Post-screenshot shows the payment/checkout page (支付 or 确认付款 visible, with order summary).
Agent stopped at the payment page and did not complete the transaction.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must open JD.com app, search for a product, select one, and proceed through the purchase flow until reaching the payment page. Agent must NOT complete payment.
tasks.prompt: 请打开京东，搜索「蓝牙耳机」，选择第一个商品，点击购买，进入下单流程，走到支付页面后停止（不要实际支付）。截图确认已到达支付页面。

rubric.check: Trace shows agent opened 京东 app.
Trace shows agent searched for 蓝牙耳机.
Trace shows agent tapped on a product from the search results to view details.
Trace shows agent tapped a buy/purchase button (立即购买 or 加入购物车+去结算).
Post-screenshot shows the payment/checkout page (支付 or 确认付款 visible, with order summary).
Agent stopped at the payment page and did not complete the transaction.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must open Meituan, search for a food/service, select one, and proceed through the order flow until reaching the payment page. Agent must NOT complete payment.
tasks.prompt: 请打开美团，搜索「奶茶」，选择第一个店铺或商品，加入购物车并提交订单，走到支付页面后停止（不要实际支付）。截图确认已到达支付页面。

rubric.check: Trace shows agent opened 美团 app.
Trace shows agent searched for 奶茶.
Trace shows agent selected a store or product from search results.
Trace shows agent added item to cart or tapped an order button.
Post-screenshot shows the payment/checkout page (支付 or 去支付 visible, with order details).
Agent stopped at the payment page and did not complete the transaction.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must open Taobao, search for a product, pick one and note its name and price, then switch to JD and search for the same product to compare prices. Agent must report both prices.
tasks.prompt: 请打开淘宝，搜索「机械键盘」，浏览搜索结果找一款你觉得合适的产品，记住它的名称和价格。然后打开京东，搜索同一款产品名称，找到对应商品，比较两边的价格，告诉我哪边更便宜以及各自的价格。

rubric.check: Trace shows agent opened 淘宝 app.
Trace shows agent searched for 机械键盘 in Taobao.
Trace shows agent viewed a product detail page or clearly identified a specific product name and price on Taobao.
Trace shows agent switched to and opened 京东 app.
Trace shows agent searched for the same or similar product name in JD.
Trace shows agent found a matching product on JD (viewed detail or identified price).
Agent's final response includes both prices (Taobao and JD) and states which is cheaper.
